DTC Brand Owner
Can I use Lovart ads for commercial campaigns?
Yes! All assets generated on paid plans come with a full commercial license, allowing you to run paid traffic on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and Google without copyright issues.
How does text generation work for ads?

Lovart uses advanced models (like Nano Banana Pro) capable of rendering legible text. Plus, our 'Text Edit' feature lets you correct or rewrite any text element directly on the image, ensuring perfect copy.
What sizes can I generate?
You can generate in any aspect ratio. Common presets include 1:1 (Feed), 9:16 (Stories/Reels), and 16:9 (Video feeds). Our 'Smart Resize' adapts one design to all formats.
Does it support video ads?
Yes. With the Seedance 2.0 integration, you can turn text prompts or static images into high-quality, motion-rich video creatives suitable for social media ads.
Is it better than Canva templates?
Canva uses templates everyone has seen. Lovart generates unique, never-before-seen creatives tailored to your specific prompt, giving you a competitive edge in the feed.
